title: Just Juice Mint Range Blue Mint Saltfill Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Blue Mint Saltfill delivers the bold simplicity of Peppermint. Clean and cooling with a crisp finish, this flavour highlights the sharp clarity of mint in a timeless all-day vape. Each Saltfill bottle holds 40ml of e-liquid in a 60ml shortfill format, leaving space for one or two nicotine shots depending on your preference. Blended at 60PG/40VG, these e-liquids are optimised for pod kits and MTL devices, providing bright flavour and a satisfying throat hit. Crafted with double-concentrated flavouring, Just Juice Saltfills ensure every puff retains a strong and consistent taste. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
